blocks.content:
A panel snapshot publicly shares an interactive panel while removing sensitive data such as queries and panel links, leaving only visible metrics and series names. Anyone with the link can view it.

In this guide, you'll learn how to:

- Open a dashboard and create a panel snapshot
- Set a name and expiration, then publish
- Copy the snapshot link
- View and delete snapshots from the Snapshots page
Start by opening any dashboard that has at least one panel. You need the Editor role or higher to create snapshots.
Open any dashboard that contains at least one panel. Stay on that dashboard for the next section.
You should be viewing a dashboard with panels ready to share.
In the next section, you will open a panel's menu, select **Share snapshot**, set an expiration, and publish it so it's ready to share.
Follow along to learn how to share a snapshot of a chosen panel.

steps.description: Open the menu by hovering on a panel and clicking the three-dot vertical icon.
In **Snapshot name**, enter a descriptive title.
Under **Expires in**, choose **1 Hour**, **1 Day**, **1 Week**, or **Never**.

steps.reftarget: button[data-testid='data-testid share snapshot copy url button']
steps.description: Click **Copy link** then share it with anyone who should view the snapshot.
Close the share drawer when you're done

blocks.title: Create a panel snapshot and copy the snapshot link

blocks.content: Anyone with the link can open the snapshot and see the panel's visible metrics — without your queries or panel links.
In the next section, you will learn how to view all the snapshots you have published and delete snapshots you no longer need.
Click a row to view the snapshot.
To remove a snapshot, click the red **X** on that row. Deletion is immediate and may require additional permission. Clear your browser cache or use a private window if the link still works.

---

You did it! 🎉

You've published a panel snapshot, copied its link, and learned how to manage snapshots from **Dashboards > Snapshots**. For more sharing options, see [Share dashboards and panels](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/latest/visualizations/dashboards/share-dashboards-panels/#panel-snapshot).
